$summary: Duration and easing, plus the roles that name which band a transition belongs to.

motion.summary: Duration and easing. The duration bands are generated from the theme's {fast, medium, slow, ratio} seed; the roles below name which band a transition belongs to.
use: transition-duration / transition-timing-function, via a role (motion.interactive.*, motion.overlay.*, motion.modal.*) rather than a raw duration when one names the situation.

scale.duration.fast-min: Fastest step of the fast band.
scale.duration.fast-max: Slowest step of the fast band.
scale.duration.medium-min: Fastest step of the medium band.
scale.duration.medium-max: Slowest step of the medium band.
scale.duration.slow-min: Fastest step of the slow band.
scale.duration.slow-max: Slowest step of the slow band.
scale.duration.spin-reduced: A slowed spinner rotation for prefers-reduced-motion.
